g.text: Each dot is a real example, and each colour is a class. Left shows a saved layout. Right shows where the same points would go after one
suggestion. The separation score rises from about -0.21 to -0.16, although many colours still mix. This is an illustration using a suggestion
from another saved experiment, not a recorded before-and-after training result. The model has not been retrained here.
